svg.text: The piece runs as one long chain in time—from defining the crisis and its statistics, through its 2010s origins
and the evidence across fields, into two converging clusters of causes, then out to public reaction and a spine of
reforms—so the diagram is a chain with two zoom-able cause clusters in the middle.

g.text: A chain from definition through origins and evidence, into two clusters of causes, then outward to response and reform.
